# Spacing, radius, elevation, layout

Source: `tokens.json` (`space`, `radius`, `shadow`, `layout`, `z`, `breakpoint`). Values are logical pixels (dp in the app); `shadow` and `breakpoint` are web hints.

## Spacing scale

Group by proximity and alignment; do not wrap every label in a card.

| Token | Value | Used for |
|---|---|---|
| `space-1` | 4px | Tight stacks and icon-to-text gaps |
| `space-2` | 8px | Gap between buttons, chips, badges |
| `space-3` | 12px | Default gap of `stack` and `row`, dialog body gap |
| `space-4` | 16px | Card padding at 390, page gap at 1440, grid gap |
| `space-5` | 20px | Card padding at 1440, page gap at 1920 |
| `space-6` | 24px | Content padding top and bottom, hero padding |

## Radius

| Token | Value | Role | Used for |
|---|---|---|---|
| `radius-field` | 9px | Field | Input, select, textarea, option list, booking card, A5 sheet |
| `radius-control` | 10px | Control | Buttons, segmented-control track, skip link |
| `radius-tile` | 12px | Tile | Notice, box, soft card, list box rows, code block, image placeholder, board, icon tile, segmented item |
| `radius-card` | 14px | Card | Card, panel, table wrapper, KPI tile, empty state, trace run |
| `radius-modal` | 20px | Modal | Dialog, bottom sheet (top corners), native-dialog drawing |
| `radius-hero` | 24px | Hero | Hero band |
| `radius-pill` | 999px | Pill | Badge, chip, avatar, progress bar, count bubble, radio |

The app uses 18 for a card and 14 for controls (`pema-design/references/visual-system.md`); the web does not copy them mechanically.

## Elevation

Depth comes from the border and one of two shadows. Never mix recipes on a screen.

| Token | Value | Role | Used for |
|---|---|---|---|
| `shadow-card` | `0 5px 18px rgb(18 61 99 / 6%)` | Card shadow | Card, panel, KPI tile, empty state, frame border, selected segment, A5 sheet |
| `shadow-pop` | `0 30px 100px rgb(18 43 70 / 25%)` | Pop shadow | Dialog, bottom sheet, drawer, dropdown list, toast, native dialog (the only shadow that floats) |

## Layout

| Token | Value | Used for |
|---|---|---|
| `layout-sidebar-w` | 232px | Sidebar width above 1000px |
| `layout-sidebar-w-narrow` | 208px | Sidebar width at and below 1000px (old web) |
| `layout-topbar-h` | 60px | Top bar height |
| `layout-topbar-h-wide` | 64px | Top bar height from 1600px (frame 1920) |
| `layout-content-pad-x` | 28px | Page content padding left and right at 1440 and 1920 (16px at 390) |
| `layout-content-pad-y` | 24px | Page content padding top and bottom |
| `layout-content-max` | 1640px | Widest the page content grows on a big screen |
| `layout-aside-w` | 360px | Second column of a split workspace |
| `layout-touch-min` | 44px | Smallest touch target; buttons and chips are 44px high on a phone, 36-40px on a desktop |

## Frame sizes of the canvases

| Frame | Size | Top bar | Content padding x | Page gap | Card padding |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Desktop | 1440 x 900 | 60px | 28px | 16px | 20px |
| Wide | 1920 x 1020 | 64px | 28px | 20px | 20px |
| Phone | 390 x 844 | 56px | 16px | 16px | 16px |

Breakpoint `wide` is 100rem (1600px): the step the old web used for four-column grids and the taller top bar.

## Touch targets

Minimum 44px. Buttons and chips are 44px high on a phone and 40px (buttons) or 36px (chips) on a desktop; native app controls keep 48.

## Stacking order

| Token | Value | Used for |
|---|---|---|
| `z-sticky` | 5 | Sticky table head, sticky toolbar |
| `z-topbar` | 30 | Top bar |
| `z-drawer` | 50 | Phone drawer and its scrim |
| `z-modal` | 55 | Dialog and bottom sheet |
| `z-toast` | 60 | Toast |

## Values the canvas draws off the scale

Small sizes that have no token. They are fixed by the component, not chosen per screen.

| Value | Where |
|---|---|
| 4px, 6px, 8px radius | legend swatch, checkbox and id chip, photo tag |
| 6px | badge dot gap and dot size |
| 10px, 14px, 18px | list row and card paddings in dense blocks |
| 56px | time column of the board, phone top bar |
